classification: Local wallet experiment with fictional accounts, a fictional organisation and test keys. Real walt.id issuer and wallet software; simulated receiving websites; no WordPress, no human wallet user, no real organisation.

components.credential: dc+sd-jwt (SD-JWT VC), ES256, holder key binding (cnf.jwk), IETF Token Status List reference
components.verifier: Unanym src/wallet (this branch): OpenID4VP direct_post, redirect_uri client identifier, SD-JWT + KB-JWT verification, status list signature/subject/freshness

checks.name: independent issuer delivered an SD-JWT VC to the existing wallet
the wallet presented to Unanym over OpenID4VP 1.0
only requested claims were disclosed (member name withheld)
membership linked to the signed-in account
replaying the same response is refused
a captured presentation replayed into a new request is refused
both websites receive the wallet-verified membership
no holder key, credential signature, status reference or credential timestamp reaches either website
organisation withdrawal closes future access within the bound (refresh 5 s)
withdrawing sharing consent stops that website only
a replacement wallet and credential keep the same website account
a status outage fails closed within the freshness bound (20 s + 5 s refresh)
a member without a wallet completes the hosted journey
